comment: Single source of truth for the SPFN Mobile module graph. Canonical format: exactly one module object per line inside "modules". Consumed by tools/validate/validate.sh and tools/cocoapods-compat/generate-podspec.sh.
notes: A module exists here only once it carries an implementation. The persistence/sync and hybrid modules were declared in the Step 1 scaffold, never implemented, and published as empty coordinates through 0.1.0-alpha.3; they were dropped from the train instead. Adding one back means adding it with behaviour.
Dependency edges are a Step 1 scaffold proposal derived from the layered design; they carry no implementation and may be revised in Step 2.

The client module gained edges to auth and generated with the session change set: a session assembles a clientProofV1 proof (auth) over a generated operation and its generated request type. The transport boundary inside the same module still depends on core alone.

schemaVersion 2 added two keys with the provider adapter modules. `swiftTrait` names the SwiftPM trait that switches a target's external dependency on, and is absent on every module that has none. `externalDeps` is the ALLOWLIST the validator holds each platform's manifests to: an external dependency that is not listed here fails, and a listed one that no manifest declares fails too.

Neither new key is a substring of another key in this file and neither appears twice on a module line, so a line-scoped extraction cannot read one where it meant the other (docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PITFALLS.md P5). `swiftTrait` and `swiftTarget` share a prefix on purpose-free grounds only: every reader matches the full quoted key name, never a prefix.

The Android names in `externalDeps` are version-catalogue aliases with dots replaced by hyphens: `libs.play.services.auth` is `play-services-auth`. The Swift names are the SwiftPM package identity, which is the last path component of the repository URL.
